name: Piano stabs
why: Bright piano chords banged out in a pushed, offbeat rhythm. Nothing says early-90s dance floor faster.

ingredients.name: A piano
ingredients.adds: Sampled grand piano chords, each held for its full step.

ingredients.name: Play it short
ingredients.adds: Fingers come off the keys early.

knobs.label: note length
knobs.below: Pecks, with no chord in them.

ingredients.name: Thin it out
ingredients.adds: Removes the low notes of the piano so the bass has the bottom to itself.

ingredients.name: Room
ingredients.adds: Puts the piano in a hall.
